# Grey Matter

> Free South African high school e-learning platform for Grades 10–12. 
> Covers 8 CAPS-aligned subjects with interactive multiple-choice exercises, 
> chapter notes, and progress tracking. No paywalls, no sign-up required to browse.

## Subjects

- [Accounting](https://greymatterschool.co.za/accounting/): Financial statements, ledgers, reconciliations
- [Business Studies](https://greymatterschool.co.za/business/): Business environments, operations, ventures
- [Economics](https://greymatterschool.co.za/economics/): Micro, macro, economic pursuits
- [Geography](https://greymatterschool.co.za/geography/): Climatology, geomorphology, settlement
- [Life Sciences](https://greymatterschool.co.za/life-science/): Cells, genetics, ecology, human systems
- [Physical Sciences](https://greymatterschool.co.za/physics/): Mechanics, waves, electricity, chemistry
- [Mathematical Literacy](https://greymatterschool.co.za/maths-lit/): Finance, data, measurement
- [Mathematics](https://greymatterschool.co.za/mathematics/): Algebra, calculus, trigonometry, statistics

## About

- [How It Works](https://greymatterschool.co.za/how-it-works/): Study method and retake guidance
- [About Grey Matter](https://greymatterschool.co.za/about/): Mission and scope
- [Help & FAQ](https://greymatterschool.co.za/help/): Common questions
- [Contact](https://greymatterschool.co.za/contact/): Support
